title: OnAir data
description: View the last CSV export loaded in this session.
noProjectsBody: Add a project in Settings to view its OnAir export.
folderMissingBody: Open Settings and configure the PA CSV directory for {{project}}.

loadProjectsError.title: Projects could not be loaded
loadProjectsError.body: Try opening OnAir again. If the problem continues, review the project in Settings.

empty.title: The snapshot has no groups
empty.body: Refresh the CSV export after the rundown is available.

generic.title: Could not read the export
generic.body: The last successful snapshot remains visible. Try refreshing again.

NOT_CONFIGURED.title: No export directory configured
NOT_CONFIGURED.body: Configure the PA CSV directory for this project in Settings.

PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.title: Project no longer exists
PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.body: Return to Settings and select an available project.

READ_FAILED.title: Export could not be read
READ_FAILED.body: The CSV files could not be read. The last successful snapshot remains visible.

INVALID_CSV.title: Invalid CSV export
INVALID_CSV.body: The export contains invalid data. The last successful data remains visible.

FILES_CHANGED.title: Export changed during refresh
FILES_CHANGED.body: The files changed while they were being read. The previous snapshot remains visible.

SOURCE_CHANGED.title: Export source changed
SOURCE_CHANGED.body: The configured export source changed. Review the project directory in Settings.

SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Project settings are invalid
SETTINGS_INVALID.body: Review this project's OnAir settings before refreshing.
